mapper.select: SELECT id, attachment_id, business_type, business_id, relation_type, sort_order, remark, created_time FROM system_attachment_relation WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{relationId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO system_attachment_relation (tenant_id, attachment_id, business_type, business_id, relation_type, sort_order, remark, created_by) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{attachmentId}, #{request.businessType}, #{request.businessId}, #{request.relationType}, COALESCE(#{request.sortOrder}, 0), #{request.remark}, #{operatorId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM system_attachment_relation WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{relationId}
